youtube_title: Why Airport Chai Costs SO Much ☕✈️ #Shorts
youtube_description:
Same chai, same paper cup, many times the price. Two hidden reasons: airport outlets pay high rent and fees (that cost goes into your cup), and after security you can't step out, so there's no competition.

In a LocalCircles survey of airline passengers (Dec 2024), about half said they paid 2x to 3x city prices. Since Dec 2024, some airports have an UDAN Yatri Cafe with ₹10 water and cheap chai/snacks.

Rule: carry an empty bottle and refill after security, pack snacks, and look for the UDAN Yatri Cafe.

Sources: LocalCircles survey via Business Standard (12 Dec 2024); IANS on UDAN Yatri Cafe (Jan 2025).
